target.name: food_insecure_label
target.note: Estimated probability of food insecurity, not an eligibility decision.

actions.stable_or_low_need: Things look fairly steady right now. General resources may still be useful.
actions.prevention_support: A little help now — like budgeting support — could keep small problems from growing.
actions.benefit_navigation: Getting signed up for benefits like SNAP, WIC, or school meals could help the most.
actions.housing_emergency: Housing looks like the urgent need — rent help, eviction help, or utility help.
actions.severe_multiple_hardship: Several needs at once. Someone who can coordinate different kinds of help would fit best.

form_fields.name: household_size
form_fields.label: How many people live in your home?

form_fields.name: children_count
form_fields.label: How many of them are kids (under 18)?

form_fields.name: monthly_income_usd
form_fields.label: How much money does your household get each month?
form_fields.helper: Add up everything everyone brings in — pay, benefits, all of it.

form_fields.name: employment_status
form_fields.label: Does the main earner have a job?
form_fields.helper: Pick what fits best right now.

form_fields.name: income_volatility
form_fields.label: Is that money about the same every month?
form_fields.helper: Some jobs pay the same each month; others go up and down.

form_fields.name: savings_buffer_days
form_fields.label: If the money stopped, how many days could savings cover the basics?
form_fields.helper: A rough guess is fine. 0 means no savings to fall back on.

form_fields.name: benefits_snap
form_fields.label: Does your household get SNAP (food stamps)?

form_fields.name: monthly_housing_cost_usd
form_fields.label: How much do you pay for housing each month?
form_fields.helper: Rent or mortgage. Put 0 if you pay nothing.

level_labels.own_mortgage: Own it, still paying it off

form_fields.name: behind_on_housing_payment
form_fields.label: Are you behind on rent or mortgage?

form_fields.name: utility_shutoff_notice
form_fields.label: Had a shut-off warning for a utility lately?
form_fields.helper: Like a notice that power, water, or gas might be turned off.

form_fields.name: transportation_access
form_fields.label: How easy is it to get around?

level_labels.reliable: Easy — I have a reliable ride
level_labels.no_vehicle_or_transit: Very hard — no car or bus

form_fields.name: distance_to_grocery_miles
form_fields.label: How far is the nearest grocery store, in miles?
form_fields.helper: A real grocery store, not a corner shop.

form_fields.name: chronic_health_condition
form_fields.label: Does anyone at home have an ongoing health condition?
form_fields.helper: Something long-term, like diabetes or asthma.

derived_fields.name: rent_or_mortgage_burden_pct
derived_fields.description: The share of your money that goes to housing.

derived_fields.name: income_to_poverty_ratio
derived_fields.description: Your income compared with the official poverty line.

derived_fields.name: food_desert_flag
derived_fields.description: Whether it's hard to reach a grocery store.
